tools.purpose: Find a username across 400+ social networks
tools.description: Checks whether a username is registered on hundreds of social sites. You get the profile links it could confirm.

inputs.label: Usernames
inputs.placeholder: one or more, separated by spaces

inputs.label: Sites
inputs.help: Limit the check to these site names.

tools.purpose: Build a dossier on a username across 3000+ sites
tools.description: Builds a dossier for one or more usernames by checking thousands of sites. You get the matching profiles and an optional report.

inputs.label: Usernames
inputs.placeholder: one or more, separated by spaces

inputs.label: Permute name variants
inputs.help: Turns two or more words, such as a full name, into likely usernames.

tools.purpose: Community-maintained username enumeration dataset
tools.description: A maintained dataset of how to check a username on hundreds of sites. This repo does not scan by itself; clients such as whatsmyname.app use the username against that list.

tools.purpose: Check email/username availability on major platforms
tools.description: Checks whether usernames or email addresses are still available on major platforms. You get which ones are taken and which are free.

inputs.label: Usernames or emails
inputs.help: Space-separated. Each item can be a username or an email.

tools.purpose: Correlate profiles across social sites via facial recognition
tools.description: Matches faces from a company name, a CSV, or a folder of images to profiles on the social sites you pick. You get a report of likely profile matches.

inputs.label: Sites
inputs.help: At least one of facebook, twitter, instagram, linkedin, googleplus, vkontakte, weibo, douban, or all.

tools.purpose: Check if an email is registered on 120+ sites
tools.description: Checks whether an email address is registered on more than 120 websites. You get the list of sites where an account exists.

tools.purpose: Gather emails, names, subdomains and IPs from public sources
tools.description: Collects public hostnames, emails, IPs, and URLs for a domain from the sources you choose. You get those discovered names and addresses.

inputs.label: Sources
inputs.help: Comma-separated source names or capability selectors such as subdomains, emails, ips, urls.

inputs.label: Limit
inputs.help: Per-source result cap. 0 removes the local cap.

tools.purpose: Email breach hunting and password leak lookup
tools.description: Looks up emails in breach data. You get the leak hits it finds for those addresses.

tools.purpose: Automated email OSINT (breaches, socials, DNS)
tools.description: Runs breach, social, and DNS checks for one email address. You get a combined report on that address.

tools.purpose: Derive a phone number from an email via password-reset leaks
tools.description: Tries to recover phone-number digits linked to an email from public password-reset pages, or builds a number list from a mask. You get the digits or the generated numbers.

tools.purpose: Investigate Google accounts from an email or Gaia ID
tools.description: Looks up public Google account data from an email, a Gaia ID, a Drive file, or a Wi-Fi BSSID. You get the profile and linked Google data that module can see.

inputs.label: Query
inputs.placeholder: email, Gaia ID, Drive URL, or BSSID

tools.purpose: Check an email for leaked credentials and reuse across sites
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/D4Vinci/Cr3dOv3r && pip3 install -r requirements.txt
tools.description: Checks an email or username against known credential leaks. You get whether leaked passwords were found for it.

tools.purpose: Scan international phone numbers using free resources
tools.install: Download release binary or docker pull sundowndev/phoneinfoga
tools.description: Scans a phone number and returns its country, carrier, and line type, plus any public footprint the configured scanners find.

tools.purpose: Check if a phone number is used on sites (Instagram, Snapchat…)
tools.description: Checks whether a phone number is used on sites such as Instagram and Snapchat. You get the sites where that number appears.

tools.purpose: In-depth attack surface mapping and subdomain discovery
tools.description: Maps a domain's publicly visible names. You get the subdomains and related names the enum command discovers.

tools.purpose: Fast passive subdomain enumeration
tools.description: Finds subdomains for a domain from passive sources. You get the hostname list.

tools.purpose: Classic subdomain enumeration via search engines
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/aboul3la/Sublist3r && pip install -r requirements.txt
tools.description: Enumerates subdomains with search engines and an optional brute-force step. You get the subdomain names it collects.

tools.purpose: High-performance bulk DNS resolver
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/blechschmidt/massdns && cd massdns && make
tools.description: Resolves a large list of DNS names. You get the records of the type you ask for.

tools.purpose: Multi-purpose DNS toolkit for bulk queries
tools.description: Resolves domains in bulk. You get the DNS records you select, such as A, MX, or TXT.

inputs.label: Record types
inputs.help: Leave blank for the default A lookup.

tools.purpose: Probe hosts for live HTTP services, titles, tech
tools.description: Probes hosts over HTTP. You get which ones respond, plus titles, status codes, or technologies if you turn those on.

tools.purpose: Find domains and subdomains related to a domain
tools.description: Finds domain names related to a domain. You get that name list, optionally limited to subdomains.

tools.purpose: Pull known URLs for a domain from the Wayback Machine
tools.description: Pulls URLs the Wayback Machine has stored for a domain. You get that historical URL list.

tools.purpose: All-in-one website analysis (DNS, SSL, headers, tech)
tools.description: Builds a website report for one URL. You get DNS, SSL, header, and technology details in the web-check page.

tools.purpose: All-in-one web reconnaissance (headers, whois, crawl, DNS)
tools.description: Runs the recon modules you pick against a URL. You get headers, DNS, subdomains, or a full overview, depending on the module.

tools.purpose: Screenshot websites at scale with a report UI
tools.description: Screenshots a single URL. You get the screenshot and the page data written to its database if you ask for that.

tools.purpose: Visual inspection of websites across many hosts (archived)
tools.description: Opens the web ports of a host list and screenshots them. You get an HTML report of those pages.

tools.purpose: Discover hidden HTTP parameters
tools.description: Discovers hidden HTTP parameters on a URL. You get the parameter names it finds.

tools.purpose: Interactive Instagram account OSINT shell
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/Datalux/Osintgram && pip install -r requirements.txt
tools.description: Looks up a public Instagram account, hashtag, or place in a local web app. You get profile, network, and content details, or an answer to a plain-language question.

inputs.label: Question
inputs.placeholder: how many followers, and which hashtags
inputs.help: Optional. In AI mode the username can be empty if you ask about a hashtag or a place.

tools.purpose: Download Instagram posts, stories and metadata
tools.description: Downloads posts and profile media for one or more Instagram usernames. You get the pictures, videos, and their metadata saved locally.

tools.purpose: Instagram picture/video downloader without API
tools.description: Downloads Instagram media for a user, a hashtag, or one post. You get those files in the folder you choose.

tools.purpose: Twitter scraping without API (archived, mostly broken)
tools.description: Scrapes public tweets by username or search text. You get the matching tweets. The project is archived and often no longer works against Twitter.

tools.purpose: Scraper for social networks (Reddit, Mastodon, etc.)
tools.description: Scrapes a social site using a named scraper and a query. You get the posts or profile items that scraper returns.

inputs.label: Scraper
inputs.help: Examples: twitter-user, twitter-hashtag, twitter-search, reddit-user, reddit-subreddit, reddit-search.

tools.purpose: Analyze and find a profile across 1000+ social sites
tools.description: Searches for a username across many websites. You get the profiles it detects, and page metadata if you ask for it.

tools.purpose: Investigate GitHub users, orgs and repos
tools.description: Fetches public GitHub data for a user, repository, organization, or search. You get that profile, repo, or search result.

tools.purpose: Social-engineering demo to obtain device location (consent only)
tools.description: Starts a local page for an authorized location test. If the person you are allowed to test opens the link, you get the location they share, optionally as a KML file.

tools.purpose: Digital image forensics toolset
tools.description: Opens an image in a forensics workbench. You get metadata, noise, and tampering views so you can inspect the file yourself.

tools.purpose: Archive social media posts and web evidence
tools.description: Archives social posts and web pages from URLs or a CSV of URLs. You get saved copies and a status report for each one.

tools.purpose: Read/write metadata in images, docs, video
tools.description: Reads the metadata stored in a file. You get the tags embedded in it, such as camera, GPS, author, and dates.

tools.purpose: Extract metadata from public documents of a domain
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/laramies/metagoofil && pip install -r requirements.txt
tools.description: Finds public documents for a domain, or reads a local folder of documents, and extracts their metadata. You get usernames, emails, software paths, and similar details from those files.

inputs.label: Local documents
inputs.help: Use this instead of a domain to analyze files you already have.

tools.purpose: Find metadata and hidden info in documents (Windows)
tools.description: A Windows app that finds documents for a domain and reads metadata from those files or from local files you add. You get the extracted metadata and the relationships it builds.

tools.purpose: Dark web (.onion) crawler and OSINT tool
tools.description: Crawls an onion or ordinary URL and summarizes the page. You get site information and a crawl tree up to the depth you set.

tools.purpose: Investigate onion services for opsec leaks
tools.description: Checks an onion service for common configuration leaks. You get a risk report, in text or JSON.

tools.purpose: Threat intelligence sharing platform
tools.description: A web platform for storing and sharing threat indicators. You look up an indicator and get the matching events and attributes in your MISP instance.

tools.purpose: Open cyber threat intelligence platform (STIX2)
tools.description: A web platform for threat knowledge. You look up an observable and get the linked reports and relationships stored in the instance.

tools.purpose: Organize observables, IOCs and TTPs
tools.description: A web platform that organizes indicators and attacker techniques. You search an observable and get the related intelligence stored there.

tools.purpose: OSINT automation with 200+ modules and web UI
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/smicallef/spiderfoot && pip3 install -r requirements.txt
tools.description: Runs OSINT modules against one target and correlates what they find. You get the combined scan results in the web UI or as tab, CSV, or JSON.

tools.purpose: Modular web reconnaissance framework
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/lanmaster53/recon-ng && pip install -r REQUIREMENTS
tools.description: A modular recon console. You choose a module and a source, usually a domain or company, and get that module's results.

tools.purpose: Fast crawler extracting URLs, emails, files, keys
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/s0md3v/Photon && pip install -r requirements.txt
tools.description: Crawls a website and extracts URLs, files, and related data. You get that crawl output, optionally including archived URLs and DNS names.

tools.purpose: Workflow engine for offensive recon
tools.description: Runs a recon workflow against a target. You get the assets and findings that workflow collects.

tools.purpose: Automated full recon pipeline (subdomains, vulns, OSINT)
tools.description: Runs a recon pipeline on a domain. You get subdomains, live web hosts, and the OSINT or recon output for the mode you pick.

inputs.label: Mode
inputs.help: recon is -r, passive is -p, subdomains is -s, osint is -n, all is -a.

tools.purpose: Web recon framework with UI and scan engine
tools.description: A web recon suite. You add a domain and start a scan, and get subdomains, endpoints, screenshots, and the rest of the configured pipeline.

tools.purpose: All-in-one info gathering tool (older)
tools.description: Gathers public information for a domain in the mode you choose, such as basic, DNS, or whois. You get that module's results.

inputs.label: Mode
inputs.help: Examples: basic, whois, dns, revdns, crt.

tools.purpose: The canonical awesome list of OSINT tools
tools.description: A curated reading list of OSINT links, grouped by topic. You browse the list; it does not run a scan.

tools.purpose: 1000+ OSINT tools and resources by category
tools.description: A categorized catalog of OSINT tools and resources. You browse the collection; it does not run a scan.

tools.purpose: Web tree of OSINT resources (osintframework.com)
tools.description: A clickable tree of OSINT resources by the kind of information you already have. You follow a link; it does not run a scan.
